title: 6 Hours Waiting in Busan Station… for a 2.5-Hour Train to Seoul 🇰🇷 /// #stryker336 #Shorts
description:
I ended up waiting 6 hours inside Busan Train Station just to catch a 2.5-hour high-speed train to Seoul. In this vlog, I kill time inside one of South Korea’s busiest stations — walking the halls, watching the crowds, grabbing food, and dealing with the reality of long waits while traveling. It’s not glamorous, but it’s part of real travel that doesn’t always make the highlight reels. If you’re planning to take the KTX or travel across South Korea by train, this video shows what happens when plans don’t line up and you’re stuck waiting it out. 📍 Busan Station → Seoul 🚄 High-speed train (KTX) ⏳ Long wait • travel day • real moments #stryker336
